decision: Keep the current Vision requests. Broader20-clip testing does not establish a reliable overall improvement from either drop-in revision switch: current543/615 legal with2 known false, pose2 535/615 with2 known false, tracker2 540/615 with4 known false. Gains and losses coexist; selected repeats vary. Tracker2 extra false counts in normal4 did not recur on repeat, so report the risk and variability rather than a deterministic regression. The earlier repeated pose2 false ground bounce in IMG8606 remains outside these20-cohort totals. No release or default change is justified by these results.
